change_from_admission: no momentum exclusion: independent frequency reference, changed coverage declared; no new backtest
issuance_time_policy: actual independently evidenced registration within window; never call planned deadline actual issuedAt
missed_issue_policy: append omission for that month; no replacement, backdating or later same-month issue

sources.history: official ALFRED UNRATE realtime archive captured and externally committed before cut; latest observed reference month must equal target minus two months
sources.base: archived seasonally adjusted civilian national unemployment rate, percent age16plus, fixed at issue
sources.capture: HTTPS official source, original bytes and hash, release metadata and acquisition provenance private; no invented historical availability

resolution.source: first BLS Employment Situation household survey national seasonally adjusted unemployment rate
resolution.late_capture: MISSING_INITIAL unless independent immutable first-edition evidence is established; never substitute current revised data
resolution.missing_release: retain unresolved until actual initial release, record delay; never impute event=0
resolution.corrections: first published number is primary outcome; corrected and revised results separate sensitivity, no overwrite
resolution.base_revisions: retain issued base even if later revised

review.interpretation: preliminary pilot only; no general predictive usefulness or decision recommendation from 12 targets
